Aisha (CSM): Kickoff for NebulaRx onboarding — aim to have first production inference calls by 2025-06-10. Quick run-down: stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, and risks. Who can confirm availability for weekly 30m syncs?
Ben (Eng): I can do Tue/Thu mornings PST. For eng work we'll need model spec + data access.
Evan (Solutions): I'll own runbook and enablement kit. Plan: 2 enablement sessions (dev + ops) before go-live.
Clara (Customer): Confirmed — Raj and I will attend. Priority is PII-safe telemetry and <3s median latency for lookup flows. Renewal discussion tied to SLA adoption.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. Primary success criteria (proposed):
• 1) Prod traffic accepted with sample rate 100rps for 48h without errors
• 2) Token cost within 20% of projected baseline
• 3) SLOs: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 1200ms for their typical 512-token requests
• 4) Observability: app traces + per-route cost broken out in console
Ben (Eng): Technical checklist:
• Access to NebulaRx staging VPC (IAM list from Raj)
• Model version pinned (we recommend rdx-1.4-quant)
• Canary route with fallback to rdx-1.3 if latency regresses
• KV prefix caching enabled for chat-like sessions
Evan (Solutions): Enablement plan:
• Week 1: Platform onboarding + API keys + network setup (recording + slides)
• Week 2: Integration lab — we run sample traffic and validate traces
• Week 3: Runbook rehearsals + rollback tests
Aisha (CSM): Timeline (rough):
• 2025-05-12: kickoff (today)
• 2025-05-16: staging network + keys complete
• 2025-05-23: first integration lab (1h)
• 2025-05-30: canary rollout start (10% traffic)
• 2025-06-10: target prod acceptance
Clara (Customer): Risk flags from our side: delayed cert rotation (security) and internal change freeze on 2025-05-28. We may need a short exception window.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks — we'll add security owner to sync. Raj, can you provide IAM list by 2025-05-14?
Raj (Dev Lead): Yep, will post the list tomorrow morning.
onboard-bot: Playbook created: https://console.redwood.ai/playbooks/nebularx-onboard-4790012345 (auto-generated) :white_check_mark:
Ben (Eng): Quick note on costs — enable batching for bulk lookups and quantize to int8 in staging; I'll run perf tests and post numbers.
Evan (Solutions): We'll capture feedback in a shared Airtable and export weekly snapshots into the project channel. Add any test prompts you want us to run.
Aisha (CSM): Action items captured:
1) Raj -> IAM list by 2025-05-14
2) Ben -> perf + cost numbers (int8 vs fp16) by 2025-05-20
3) Evan -> enablement slides + lab invite by 2025-05-15
4) Clara -> provide top 10 test prompts and any compliance certs by 2025-05-18
5) Aisha -> weekly 30m cadence invites start 2025-05-13

Please react with :thumbsup: to confirm. If renewal risk needs escalation, flag here and I’ll loop in Sales Ops.
Clara (Customer): 👍 will do.
Ben (Eng): 👍
Evan (Solutions): 👍
Aisha (CSM): Great — next sync Tue 2025-05-13 09:00 PST. I'll drop calendar invites.
Clara (Customer): Thanks everyone.
Aisha (CSM): Closing thread for now — updates to be posted here.
